@name: Herbalist
@slug: herbalist
@category: RMFRP Core
@default_cost: 33
@description:
 [Vocational] An herbalist is a person who specializes in growing, preparing,
 and cultivating herbs. Very often, herbalists are found near urban areas
 (where demand for herbs is higher), though they also like the secluded nature
 of a more rural environment. Time to Acquire: 33 months. Starting Money:
 normal plus d10 (open-ended).
